Class AnimationMultiMenu

java.lang.Object
app.animation.AnimationMultiMenu
public class AnimationMultiMenu extends Object
The AnimationMultiMenu class provides utilities for animating menus and buttons within a JavaFX application. It allows for creating fade-in and fade-out animations and handling mouse interactions to alter opacity effect dynamically.

    • mouseInOutMultiMenu

      public void mouseInOutMultiMenu(javafx.scene.layout.HBox pane)
      Adjusts the opacity and sets up animations for fade-in and fade-out transitions when the mouse enters or exits a given HBox. It applies a smoother user interaction effect by modifying the opacity using fade transitions.
      Parameters:
      pane - The HBox component for which the mouse hover animations are to be applied.

    • buttonAnimation

      public void buttonAnimation(javafx.scene.control.Label button)
      Configures fade-in and fade-out animations for a button when hovered over by the mouse. This method sets up visual feedback by modifying the button's opacity through fade transitions on mouse enter and exit events.
      Parameters:
      button - The Label component on which the hover animations will be applied.

    • fadeOutMultiMenu

      public void fadeOutMultiMenu(javafx.scene.layout.StackPane root, javafx.scene.layout.StackPane pane)
      Plays a fade-out animation on the specified pane, transitioning its opacity from fully visible to fully transparent over a duration of 0.5 seconds. Once the fade-out animation has completed, the pane is removed from the root's children by invoking the FadeOutFinishedHandler.
      Parameters:
      root - The parent StackPane that contains the pane to be faded out.
      pane - The StackPane to apply the fade-out animation and remove upon completion.

    • closeMultiMenu

      public javafx.animation.Animation closeMultiMenu(javafx.scene.layout.StackPane pane)
      Plays a fade-out animation on the specified StackPane, transitioning its opacity from fully visible to fully transparent over a duration of 0.5 seconds.
      Parameters:
      pane - The StackPane to which the fade-out animation will be applied.
      Returns:
      The Animation object representing the fade-out transition.
